title: Event materials
slide_intent: Connect event materials to shared templates because a temporary setting still needs to be identifiable as the same city.
strategic_value: The indoor/outdoor template route can help Helsinki maintain continuity across event settings.
demonstration: This webpage component introduces indoor and outdoor event-material templates, links to Finnish event-material guidelines and includes an Open all control. No event-template specimen appears.
practical_value: Follow the event-material route when designing for an indoor or outdoor occasion.

content_islands.name: Event template route
content_islands.spec: Place the indoor/outdoor description and Finnish guidelines link beneath the heading, above the expansion control.

reference_purposes.Application: The text identifies indoor/outdoor event templates and links to their guidelines.
